ns2:section.sectionText: PERSONAL FINANCIAL PLANNING - Reserved for LAS Juniors & Seniors only. A survey of the financial planning process and industry, this course covers investment, tax, insurance, and retirement planning. Applicable to those interested in creating a sound personal financial plan early in one's working career and those interested in becoming a financial planner. The course meets the first 8 weeks of the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to Liberal Arts & Sciences. Restricted to students with Junior or Senior class standing.
